clue.text: Dean's kebab changed for another dish

indicators.note: changed tells us the letters of the two words are put into a different order

explanation.surface: Dean swaps his kebab for some other food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' turns the letters of DEANS KEBAB into a new order. 'another dish' works because a kebab is already a dish.
explanation.definitionFit: This tinned staple of haricots in tomato sauce is a food in its own right, so it is a second plate beside the kebab.

parts.note: AM is the usual abbreviation for the morning (ante meridiem)
employment of something is its use

explanation.surface: Someone is moved off their morning job.
explanation.definitionFit: To divert someone is to entertain them, a synonym of the answer.

parts.note: EX is a prefix meaning former, as in ex-wife
a pen is a writer, and the 's gives the S
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A retired author spends a lot of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: An outlay is money spent, a cost.

clue.text: Bringing container up leads to objection

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards, backwards

parts.note: a tub is a container

explanation.surface: Carrying a bin upstairs prompts a complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: An objection is a reservation, as in 'no ifs or buts'.

indicators.note: worried here means shaken about, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: People taking turns are relaxed about lateness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' rearranges LATE and ARENT into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To alternate is to do things one after another in turn, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Ace maybe to be employed in Forces

definitions.meaning: in tennis an ace is one kind of winning delivery of the ball
to work in the army or navy is to do military duty

explanation.definitionFit: An ace is an example of a tennis delivery, and soldiers are said to do duty in the military with this verb.

parts.note: IN means fashionable or popular
to land a prize is to win it

explanation.surface: A crowd-pleasing victory far from the coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Inland places lie in the interior, far from any coast.

parts.note: a pup is a young dog
a pet is a favourite, someone much liked

explanation.surface: Judy's beloved puppy.
explanation.walkthrough: Judy is the wife in Punch and Judy, the traditional British seaside show with glove figures; 'Perhaps' marks her as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Judy is a glove figure in the Punch and Judy show, an example of a marionette-type figure.

indicators.note: extremely means take the extreme letters, the first and last, of the word tacky

parts.note: a rant is a tirade

explanation.surface: A cruel ruler delivers a tasteless outburst.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', linking definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A despot who rules harshly is an oppressor.

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A ship of some interest to a family member.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' suggests a ship, but it is a blood vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A blood-carrying tube in the body is a blood vessel.

clue.text: Standard plan to include Southern cheese

parts.note: par is the standard, as in 'up to par'

indicators.note: to include says the plan word takes the southern letter inside it

parts.note: to mean to do something is to plan or intend it

explanation.surface: A normal scheme to stock a cheese from the south.
explanation.definitionFit: This hard Italian grating cheese from around Parma is a well-known example.

indicators.note: leaving means the letters of I'm go out of the longer word

explanation.surface: Someone asks if they are rude and says they are going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' takes IM off the front of IMPERTINENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something relevant to the matter in hand is appropriate.

clue.text: A very quiet organ to come into view

parts.note: pp (pianissimo) is the musical marking for very quiet
the ear is an organ of the body

explanation.surface: A soft-voiced church organ appears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organ' suggests the musical instrument, but it is a body part.
explanation.definitionFit: To come into view is to emerge or become visible.

parts.note: a role is a position or job

explanation.surface: A job offer for a personal assistant.
explanation.definitionFit: Parole is a word of honour given, originally by prisoners, a promise.

clue.text: Work schedule of motoring group assuming good finish

indicators.note: assuming here means taking on board, so the motoring letters take the other pieces inside them

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, the British motoring organisation
an end is a finish

explanation.surface: A drivers' club plans its meetings hoping for a happy ending.
explanation.walkthrough: The AA is Britain's Automobile Association, a breakdown and motoring club.
explanation.definitionFit: An agenda is a list of business to be dealt with, a plan of work.

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter is taken, here the second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: A monarch's side looks consistently gloomy.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', linking definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A sovereign of an empire is a ruler.

indicators.note: That's different signals that the letters just given are rearranged into a different word

explanation.surface: Someone marvels at fancy holidays as a change.
explanation.definitionFit: Prestige is status and allure, close in sense to glamour.

clue.text: Table item: seems pretty obvious one's needed initially

indicators.note: initially means the first letters of the words seems, pretty, obvious, one's and needed are taken

explanation.surface: A diner remarks it is plain that one piece of cutlery is required.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutlery set out for a meal includes this eating utensil.

clue.text: Ultimately keep to leaner dark meat

indicators.note: Ultimately means the final letter of each of the words keep, to, leaner and dark

explanation.surface: Advice to stick with lean rather than dark meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dark' looks to belong to the definition, but its last letter is part of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Pig flesh eaten as food is a meat.

clue.text: Get to adore a child? To some extent

indicators.note: To some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone wonders if they will come to love a child, in part.
explanation.definitionFit: To get to a place is to arrive at it.

clue.text: A Liberal by coastal area in recess

parts.note: a cove is a small bay on the coast

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician on holiday at a bay during the parliamentary break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recess' suggests Parliament's holiday, but it is a nook in a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: A nook set back into a wall is a recess.

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it at university

explanation.surface: A special dinner for students.
explanation.definitionFit: A lavish feast laid out on a table is a big meal.

indicators.note: used in says the oxygen symbol goes inside the southwestern letters

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A factory in the southwest uses oxygen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' looks like a factory or a noun, but it is the verb to put seed in the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: To scatter seed in soil is to plant it.

indicators.note: New signals that the letters of town and theory are made into something new, rearranged

explanation.surface: A new-town planning theory is striking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New Town' reads as a planned British town, but 'New' is the anagram signal for TOWN THEORY.
explanation.definitionFit: Something worthy of notice is remarkable, a synonym.
